items.prompt: The narrow entrance corridor of a small Moscow flat in grey early-morning light: a man lies asleep on the floor between a coat rack and the bathroom door, in shorts and one sock, as if he had simply dropped there. Seen from the doorway, his face turned away.

alt.ru: Узкая прихожая маленькой квартиры в сером утреннем свете: на полу между вешалкой и дверью в ванную спит мужчина в трусах и одном носке, лицом от нас.
alt.en: The narrow hallway of a small flat in grey morning light: a man asleep on the floor between the coat rack and the bathroom door, in shorts and one sock, face turned away.
alt.pt: O corredor estreito de um pequeno apartamento na luz cinzenta da manhã: um homem a dormir no chão entre o cabide e a porta da casa de banho, de cuecas e uma meia, de rosto virado.
alt.es: El estrecho recibidor de un piso pequeño con la luz gris de la mañana: un hombre dormido en el suelo entre el perchero y la puerta del baño, en calzoncillos y un calcetín, con la cara vuelta.

items.prompt: A bench by a Moscow institute in November at lunchtime: a young woman with dark hair and a fringe, seen in profile from a distance with her face lowered, sketches in a notebook on her knees; wet leaves on the path, bare trees, a man in a jacket standing a few steps away looking at her drawings.

alt.ru: Скамейка у института в ноябрьский обед: темноволосая девушка с чёлкой, низко склонившись, рисует в блокноте на коленях, в нескольких шагах стоит мужчина и смотрит на рисунки.
alt.en: A bench by an institute at lunchtime in November: a dark-haired young woman with a fringe bends low over a notebook on her knees, a man a few steps away looking at her drawings.
alt.pt: Um banco junto a um instituto à hora de almoço em novembro: uma jovem de cabelo escuro e franja, debruçada sobre um caderno nos joelhos, um homem a poucos passos a olhar para os desenhos.
alt.es: Un banco junto a un instituto a la hora de comer en noviembre: una joven de pelo oscuro y flequillo, inclinada sobre un cuaderno en las rodillas, un hombre a unos pasos mirando sus dibujos.

items.prompt: Evening in a small flat: a cup of tea and a notebook under a desk lamp, its pages filled with hand-drawn patterns of lines, nodes and intersections, the same elements recombined page after page like letters of one alphabet. A man's hand turns a page.

alt.ru: Вечер в маленькой квартире: под лампой чай и блокнот, страницы заполнены узорами из линий, узлов и пересечений, рука мужчины переворачивает страницу.
alt.en: Evening in a small flat: tea and a notebook under a lamp, its pages full of patterns of lines, nodes and crossings, a man's hand turning a page.
alt.pt: Noite num pequeno apartamento: chá e um caderno sob o candeeiro, páginas cheias de padrões de linhas, nós e cruzamentos, a mão de um homem a virar a página.
alt.es: Noche en un piso pequeño: té y un cuaderno bajo la lámpara, páginas llenas de patrones de líneas, nudos y cruces, la mano de un hombre pasando la página.
